adjust.title: Adjust subscription
adjust.description: Platform Owner remedies. Each one needs a reason and is written to the audit log.
adjust.extendDescription: Moves the trial end (while trialing) or the paid period end by this many days, counted from that date or from today if it has passed. A subscription in its grace period becomes active again.
adjust.grantDescription: Gives free days as goodwill. Same effect as Extend, recorded separately in the audit log.
adjust.changePlanDescription: Moves this organization to another plan, including hidden plans, and grants that plan's current limits.
adjust.planKeyHint: Type the plan key. Hidden plans are not listed; type their key.
adjust.applyPeriodEnd: At the end of the paid period
adjust.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Kept in the audit log.

internal.label: Internal (test, demo or staff)
internal.description: Internal organizations are left out of platform revenue figures. The customer never sees this setting. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

ownerWhatsapp.notShared: Not shared — the owner did not agree to WhatsApp contact.

delete.confirmHelp: The email must match exactly. This is what stops the wrong account being deleted.
delete.doneDescription: {{name}} can no longer sign in, and every session has been revoked.
delete.retainedNotice: Payments, orders and audit history were kept, and now point at an anonymised subject.

delete.alreadyDeleted: This account has already been deleted. There is nothing left to do.

rolesPermissions.title: Roles & Permissions
rolesPermissions.subtitle: Your own effective roles and permissions across Atlas.
rolesPermissions.boundaryTitle: This is an inspection view, not a catalog
rolesPermissions.boundaryDescription: Atlas does not yet define a platform-wide role/permission catalog or an assignment workflow for other users. This page shows only the roles and permissions already granted to your own signed-in account.
rolesPermissions.noRoles: No roles are assigned to your account.
rolesPermissions.noPermissions: No permissions are assigned to your account.

planCatalog.title: Plans & Add-ons
planCatalog.subtitle: The Atlas catalog of plans and add-ons.
planCatalog.boundaryDescription: Changes are audited and apply to new purchases and to subscribers who have no recorded entitlement. Customers keep the limits they were granted when they bought or started a trial, and no existing customer data is ever removed. Add-on catalog state is managed on the Add-ons Management page.
planCatalog.noPlans: No plans are currently in the catalog.
planCatalog.noAddOns: No add-ons are currently in the catalog.

adminSubscriptions.title: Subscriptions & Trials
adminSubscriptions.description: Platform-wide subscription, trial and cancellation activity.

trials.title: Free trials
trials.description: Redemption and conversion, counted from real redemption records.
trials.conversionNote: Conversion is counted as organizations that redeemed a trial and hold a paid subscription right now. It is a point-in-time figure, not a historical funnel — an organization that converted and later left is not counted here.

plans.title: Plan distribution
plans.truncated: Showing the top {{shown}} of {{total}} plans with subscriptions.

cancellations.title: Cancellations
cancellations.emptyDescription: Cancellation reasons will appear here as customers use the cancel flow.

revenue.title: Monthly recurring revenue
revenue.description: From approved subscription payments only: each active subscription’s latest approved payment, with yearly payments divided by 12. Currencies are never added together.
revenue.none: No active subscription has an approved payment yet.
revenue.withoutPayment_one: {{count}} active subscription has no approved payment on record (for example, time granted by the platform) and is not included.
revenue.withoutPayment_other: {{count}} active subscriptions have no approved payment on record (for example, time granted by the platform) and are not included.
revenue.internalExcluded: Organizations marked as internal (test, demo or staff) are not included.

history.title: Change history
history.noDetail: No change detail was recorded for this entry.
history.subscribersNotified: Organizations notified: {{notified}}. Not sent (see server logs): {{failed}}.
history.emptyDescription: Administrative changes to this plan will appear here.

editor.title: Edit {{plan}}
editor.description: Changes take effect immediately for new operations. Existing customer data is never removed.
editor.subscriberNotice: Saving a change to the price or the limits emails the owner of every paying organization on this plan, and shows them a notice on their subscription page. It applies to them from their next renewal.
editor.yearlyAmountHelp: Leave empty to offer monthly billing only. When set, customers can choose yearly billing and pay this amount once a year, in the same currency.
editor.yearlyAmountInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}, or leave it empty.
editor.pricingNote: This is catalog pricing. Completed payments keep the amount they were charged, so changing this never alters billing history.
editor.trialEligible: Offer a free trial on this plan
editor.trialDaysHelp: Leave empty to use the platform-wide trial length.
editor.giftDescription: Extra days added before the first paid period of a customer's first-ever paid subscription. Renewals, plan changes and returning customers never receive them.
editor.giftMonthlyHelp: Days gifted on a first monthly subscription. Leave empty for none.
editor.giftYearlyHelp: Days gifted on a first yearly subscription. Applies only when a yearly price is offered.
editor.giftInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave it empty for no gift.
editor.monthlyEmailsHelp: Emails each academy may send from Messages per calendar month (UTC). Leave blank for the platform default of {{count}}, or enter a number or “unlimited”.
editor.reductionDescription: Some customers may already be above the new limit. Check the impact before saving.
editor.impactNone: No organization on this plan is currently above the proposed limits.
editor.impactCount_one: {{count}} organization is already above a proposed limit:
editor.impactCount_other: {{count}} organizations are already above a proposed limit:
editor.impactUnmeasurable: Usage is not tracked for: {{keys}} — impact cannot be checked for these.
editor.impactNonDestructive: Nothing is deleted or disabled. Existing data stays intact; affected customers are only refused new items until they are back within the limit.
editor.confirmReduction: I understand the impact and want to apply this change.
editor.staleTitle: This plan changed while you were editing
editor.staleDescription: Someone else saved a change. Reload the page and reapply your edit so you do not overwrite theirs.
editor.incompleteLimits: Every limit needs a number or "unlimited". Fill in the empty fields before saving.
editor.impactProtected_one: {{count}} subscriber keeps the limits they were granted at purchase and is not affected by this edit.
editor.impactProtected_other: {{count}} subscribers keep the limits they were granted at purchase and are not affected by this edit.

watermarkLookup.title: Watermark lookup
watermarkLookup.subtitle: Trace a leaked recording to the viewer and session it was issued to.

form.label: Watermark code
form.hint: Type the ten letters and digits shown on the recording. Case, spaces and dashes don’t matter.
form.valid: Valid code — ready to look up

problems.empty: Enter the code shown on the recording.
problems.tooShort: A code has {{total}} symbols — {{typed}} entered so far.
problems.tooLong: Too many symbols — a code has exactly {{total}}, shown as XXXXX-XXXXX.
problems.symbol: These characters can’t appear in a code: {{symbols}}. Codes use digits and the letters A–Z except I, L, O and U.
problems.checksum: One symbol looks misread — re-check the recording, especially 0/O, 1/I/L, 5/S, 8/B.

watermarkLookup.auditNotice: Every lookup is recorded in the audit log.

idle.title: Read the code off the recording
idle.description: Every course video shows a code unique to the viewer and their session. Find it on the leaked recording and enter it above.
idle.sampleCaption: How the watermark appears on a video

pause.title: Pause on a clear frame
pause.body: The label moves to a new spot every 20–45 seconds, and a faint copy of the code is tiled across the whole frame. Pick the sharpest one.

read.title: Read the ten symbols
read.body: Codes are shown as two groups of five. I, L, O and U never appear, so 0/O and 1/I/L are read the same way.

enter.title: Look it up
enter.body: A misread symbol is caught here, before anything is sent. You’ll see who the code was issued to, for which content, and on which session and device.

forbidden.title: Platform Owners only
forbidden.description: Only a Platform Owner can look up watermark codes. Sign in with a Platform Owner account to continue.

deleted.title: Account deleted
deleted.body: Account deleted — identity shown is from the time the code was issued.

missing.title: Account no longer found
missing.body: The account this code was issued to no longer exists. The identity shown is from the time the code was issued.

anonymous.title: Anonymous preview
anonymous.body: This code was issued to a visitor who wasn’t signed in, watching a free preview, so there is no account or identity. Use the network, the device and the other codes from the same device to follow up.

unreadable.title: Identity snapshot unreadable
unreadable.body: The identity recorded when this code was issued couldn’t be decrypted — the record may have been altered, or the encryption key changed. The session, device and network details are still accurate.

viewer.title: Viewer at issue time
viewer.description: Who the code was issued to, as recorded at that moment.
viewer.name: Name
viewer.anonymous: Anonymous preview — the visitor wasn’t signed in, so no identity was recorded.
viewer.unreadable: The identity recorded at issue time couldn’t be decrypted.

current.title: Current account
current.name: Name
current.deletedNotice: Account deleted — identity shown is from the time the code was issued.
current.missingNotice: This account no longer exists. Identity shown is from the time the code was issued.

content.title: What was watched
content.description: The content the code was drawn over.

session.title: Session
session.description: The sign-in the code was issued under.
session.none: No signed-in session — this was an anonymous preview.

device.title: Device & network
device.description: Where the video was playing when the code was issued.
device.label: Device

activity.title: Watermark activity
activity.description: When the code was on screen, and whether anyone tried to hide it.
activity.tamperBody: The player detected the watermark being hidden or removed while this code was on screen. A recording without a visible label may have been made then.

related.title: Other codes in this session
related.description: Every other code issued to the same session — or, for an anonymous preview, the same device.
related.caption: Other codes issued in the same session

empty.title: No other codes
empty.description: No other code was issued in this session.

privacyRequests.title: Privacy requests
privacyRequests.subtitle: Requests to export or delete a person's data. Handle the oldest first; nothing in the product promises a handling time.
privacyRequests.empty: No privacy requests match this view.

detail.identity: Filed from the signed-in account and confirmed by a code sent to its verified email address.
detail.fulfilExportHint: The person can download their data from their profile for 7 days. They are emailed.
detail.fulfilDeletionHint: Deletes the account through the standard Platform Owner deletion: owned academies are archived, memberships removed, sessions ended. Check the deletion plan on the user's page first. This cannot be undone.
detail.confirmDeletionBody: Type DELETE to confirm. This cannot be undone.
detail.rejectPlaceholder: For example: an open payment dispute must be settled first.
detail.failed: The request could not be updated.

growth.title: Growth
growth.description: Organizations by sign-up week over the last {{weeks}} weeks, and how many have reached each step since.
growth.footnote: Weeks start on Monday ({{timeZone}}). Internal test, demo and staff organizations are not counted.

meter.seatsFull: All seats are taken. Revoking a membership releases its seat.
meter.weekHint: We start up to 5 academies a week (Monday to Sunday, Cairo time).
meter.weekFull: This week's 5 are reached. New academies start next week.

changePlan.title: Change plan
changePlan.description: Moves the price lock to another plan at that plan's annual catalog price today. The lock end date stays the same. To move the subscription itself, use the plan change on the subscriptions page.
changePlan.confirmTitle: Re-lock the price on another plan?
changePlan.confirmDescription: The locked price becomes {{price}} a year on {{plan}}, until {{date}}. This is recorded in the audit log.

revoke.hint: Revoking ends the price lock at the next renewal. The period already paid is not changed, and the seat is released.
revoke.title: Revoke this founding membership?
revoke.description: {{name}} keeps its current paid period. Its next renewal is at the catalog price, and its seat is released.

actions.renewal_price_notice_sent: Told the next renewal is at the catalog price

add.description: The plan's current annual catalog price is locked for 24 months. The seat and the price are confirmed by the server when you add it.
add.searchOrganization: Search academy name, owner or email
add.noOrganizations: No academy matches, or every match is already a founding academy.
add.alreadyMember: This academy is already a founding academy.

email.title: Email founders
email.description: Programme messages only, such as setup sessions or the price lock. Each owner receives the version in their language. Every send is recorded.
email.subject: Subject
email.hint: Plain text. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
email.budget: Email budget left today for this kind of message: {{remaining}} of {{limit}}.
email.overBudget: Some emails will go out tomorrow, when the daily budget resets. None are dropped.
